environment.loadMode: exact HTML via Playwright set_content in about:blank

limitations: file:// and loopback HTTP navigation were blocked by environment administrator policy in preliminary attempts. No policy was changed.
Direct file opening, actual browser restart, Firefox/Safari, touch device hardware and screen-reader behavior were not tested.
New-page reset is tested, not a full OS/browser restart. No external AI, product integration, independent review or user usability study.
